question: 查询状态为0的批次，返回批次名称、状态、当前数量和产品名称
goldenSql:
SELECT
    c.ContainerId,
    c.ContainerName,
    c.Status,
    c.Qty,
    pb.ProductName
FROM Container c
JOIN Product p
    ON c.ProductId = p.ProductId
JOIN ProductBase pb
    ON p.ProductBaseId = pb.ProductBaseId
WHERE c.Status = :status
ORDER BY c.ContainerId
FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY;

question: 按ContainerId查询批次名称、状态、当前数量以及对应产品名称
goldenSql:
SELECT TOP (100)
    c.ContainerId,
    c.ContainerName,
    c.Status,
    c.Qty,
    pb.ProductName
FROM Container c
JOIN Product p
    ON c.ProductId = p.ProductId
JOIN ProductBase pb
    ON p.ProductBaseId = pb.ProductBaseId
WHERE c.ContainerId = @container_id
ORDER BY c.ContainerId;

question: 请写一个今日工单产出的sql，使用本地交易时间
goldenSql:

    mo.MfgOrderId,
